harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a THROUGHPUT probe (kind thr): the time of a synthetic stage loop with four QMMA.SF, one LDS.128 on a write barrier and PRMT / LOP3.LUT words in front of the tensor words, inside an outer loop of N passes x 256 iterations, in which ONE control field changes per slot - words that wait on a barrier that is free, on a load in flight, on a tensor word's read barrier, the re-arm wait, yield patterns; one warp per SM against 8 / 32 / 4 x 8 / 2 x 9 warps, two repeat counts per grid (the time per iteration is a slope), and the empty loop; every slot keeps the dependency table's cells and the operand hold and computes the same checksum; the full grids ran at the card's power limit by themselves

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: 455817a tools/stallfloor/probe.py 25, second part: five cells of the dependency table on their measured floor; the hold

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256

requests.pair: throughput stage `e` (version 26): 255 passes x 256 stage iterations per thread, 1 slot(s) in the distance slot - 1 = base. What is read is the kernel's TIME (the median launch time per slot); every slot computes the same checksum - only control fields differ - and keeps the table's cells and the holds (the generator's audit); a slot whose checksum is not right in every thread-launch has no time

slots.what: the EMPTY stage: the counter tail, ISETP and BRA only (the loop's skeleton)

slots.name: base
slots.what: the base stage: the load's reader waits write barrier 1, nothing else waits; the yield flag on every word with a stall <= 11 but the NOP

slots.name: a1_1
slots.what: 1 word waits on write barrier 1 BEHIND its reader's wait (a FREE barrier)

slots.name: a1_2
slots.what: 2 words wait on the free barrier 1

slots.name: a1_4
slots.what: 4 words wait on the free barrier 1

slots.name: a1_8
slots.what: 8 words wait on the free barrier 1

slots.name: a1_16
slots.what: 16 words wait on the free barrier 1

slots.name: a1n_16
slots.what: the same 16 words wait on barrier 5, which no word of the loop arms

slots.name: a2_1
slots.what: 1 word between the load and its reader waits on the load's barrier IN FLIGHT

slots.name: a2_2
slots.what: 2 words between the load and its reader wait on the load in flight

slots.name: a2_4
slots.what: 4 words between the load and its reader wait on the load in flight

slots.name: a2_8
slots.what: 8 words between the load and its reader wait on the load in flight

slots.name: a3_r
slots.what: each of the 4 tensor words arms READ barrier 2; nothing waits on it

slots.name: a3_w
slots.what: each tensor word arms read barrier 2 and the 12 words that rewrite a tensor word's source register wait on it

slots.name: a3_d
slots.what: as a3_w, and each tensor word waits on read barrier 2 before it arms it again

slots.name: a4
slots.what: the LDS.128 waits on its own write barrier 1 before it arms it again

slots.name: a_all
slots.what: a1_16 + a3_d + a4 together (NOT one change: the sum check)

slots.name: b_none
slots.what: NO yield flag on any word

slots.name: b_tensor
slots.what: the yield flag ONLY on the tensor words (stall <= 11)

slots.name: b_alt
slots.what: the yield flag on every second word that may carry it

slots.name: base2
slots.what: the base stage again (the null of the series)
